# Nara Charm (naracharm.com)

> Nara Charm is an independent artisan jewelry house dedicated to handmade heritage and ethnic fusion jewelry. Every piece carries living cultural stories from the Himalayan plateau, Miao silverwork, and natural healing stones.

## Core Collections & Categories
- [Handmade Bracelets](https://naracharm.com/collections/bracelets): Hand-hammered Tibetan silver amulets, hand-braided cords, and crystal bracelets.
- [Necklaces & Pendants](https://naracharm.com/collections/necklaces): Heritage amulets, hand-carved jade pendants, and ethnic silver chokers.
- [Earrings](https://naracharm.com/collections/earrings): Miao filigree silver earrings, natural turquoise drops, and dangle earrings.
- [Phone Charms](https://naracharm.com/collections/phone-charms): Bohemian natural gemstone and beaded protective phone charms.
- [Tibetan Silver Collection](https://naracharm.com/collections/tibetan-silver): Hand-hammered 925 silver and genuine turquoise jewelry rooted in Tibetan folklore.
- [Miao Filigree Collection](https://naracharm.com/collections/miao-filigree): Intricate woven silver jewelry handcrafted with historical filigree techniques.

## Cultural Heritage & Craftsmanship
- [Our Craft & Standards](https://naracharm.com/our-craft): Authentic materials (925 sterling silver, untreated natural stones, silk cords), zero mass-production, direct artisan partnerships.
- [Cultural Stories](https://naracharm.com/stories): Immersive essays tracing the cultural origin, symbolic meaning, and artisan background of each piece.
- [Jewelry Meanings & Styling Guides](https://naracharm.com/blog): Comprehensive educational guides on gemstone healing meanings, crystal bracelet stacking rules, cleansing rituals, and Tibetan iconography.
- [Size & Fitting Guide](https://naracharm.com/size-guide): Wrist and neck measurement guide for handmade bracelets and pendants.

## Customer Care & Guarantee
- [Shipping Policy](https://naracharm.com/shipping): Free worldwide standard shipping on orders over $120. Tracked delivery in 5–10 business days to US, UK, CA, and AU.
- [30-Day Returns](https://naracharm.com/returns): 30-day hassle-free return and exchange policy for unworn jewelry in original packaging.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://naracharm.com/faq): Care instructions, material authenticity, sizing, and order tracking.
- [Contact Customer Care](https://naracharm.com/contact): Reach our customer care team at hello@naracharm.com.
